_about: ElevenLabs Music spec for Ghost Duels (tools/elevenlabs_music.py): one entry per music track. 'file' is where the looped pick goes in the game. Direction: README.md, 'Sound direction v3'.

tracks.name: base
tracks.role: Base game background music, loops for as long as the game is open.
tracks.prompt: Loopable background music for a cozy-spooky pirate ghost slot game, 90 seconds, A minor, 96 BPM, 3/4 waltz feel like a haunted carnival carousel aboard a ghost ship. Lead: music box and celesta playing a simple, memorable minor melody; under it pizzicato strings, a soft accordion or concertina, warm tuba or bass clarinet on the downbeats, light brushed hand drum. Now and then a wordless ghost choir 'ooh' and a soft pipe organ chord, creaking ship wood and faint wind as texture. Mysterious and charming, never scary or tense, no big build-ups, no drops, constant medium-low energy so it can play for an hour without tiring. Leaves room in the upper mids for game chimes. Seamless loop: the end flows back into the beginning. Instrumental only.

tracks.name: freespins
tracks.role: Ghost Crates free spins: the same piece, more excited (the game switches to it for the bonus).
tracks.prompt: Loopable bonus-round music for a cozy-spooky pirate ghost slot game, 60 seconds, A minor, 96 BPM: a lively 6/8 sea-shanty feel aboard a ghost ship, fast music-box and celesta runs, accordion and pizzicato strings driving, warm tuba, a wordless ghost choir more present, a low tom pulse. Treasure-hunt anticipation, exciting but still friendly and charming, never scary, no drops. Seamless loop: the end flows back into the beginning. Instrumental only.
